commits.message:
fix(pretty): maxString's dropped count sits outside the closing quote (#149)

* fix(pretty): maxString's dropped count sits outside the closing quote (rich-pretty-efq)

Pretty cut a long string and appended "+N" before JSON.stringify, so the
count was quoted as the string's own content — "Field b+316" — and copying
the rendered value yielded a string the program never held. Quote the kept
prefix first and annotate after it: "Field b"+316, the same way maxLength's
"... +N" sits beside the kept entries rather than inside the last one.

The ticket's second instance (Map/Set maxLength truncating silently) is
already fixed on master by the shared `elided()` marker every container
kind goes through; verified, nothing to change.

* docs(console): print's string-truncation count sits after the closing quote (rich-pretty-efq)

PRINT_DATA_BOUNDS' header and docs/console.md both still described maxString's
+N as inside the quotes, the form this branch removed.
